facts.fact: The Minister of Local Government and Traditional Affairs told Parliament on 19 November 2025 that the Electronic Medical Records system was being piloted in two districts; no facility count or denominator is given.

The Minister of Local Government and Traditional Affairs told Parliament on 19 November 2025 that his ministry was advancing the development of integrated systems including the Electronic Medical Records, to link to the Botswana Health Information Exchange.
